labware_name: Tube Rack 2x6 - 2 mL Tubes (12 Tubes, on 90mm Height Block)
_comment: Designed for front Slot_1 / Slot_2. Physical: height block 90.0 mm, tube rim 104.6 mm above deck, tube length 40.0 mm (tube bottom 64.6 mm above deck). XY pitch and Z rim are PLACEHOLDERS until jog-calibrated: set kinematics.calibrated=true and z_calibration.rim_z once measured.

kinematics._comment: Machine XY of well = slot A1 origin + (a1_dx - col_idx*pitch_col, a1_dy + row_idx*pitch_row). Slot_2 origin = (103.0, 13.0), Slot_1 origin = (238.2, 13.0).

z_calibration._comment: rim_z = machine Z (mm from home) where the tip end is level with the tube rim. Jog to A1, lower until tip is at the rim, enter that Z here. Liquid moves are BLOCKED while rim_z is null.
